title: ArticleBrief
description: Schema for article briefs initiating the technical blog production workflow

topic.description: Full topic or title assignment of the technical article

blog_type.description: Canonical blog type strictly referenced from 00_SKILL/BLOG_TAXONOMY_CANONICAL_v1.0.md

technical_focus.description: Key technical aspects, physics principles, or standards to be addressed

created_at.description: Timestamp when the brief was created

created_by.description: Initiator name or role (e.g., Lead Engineer, Orchestrator)
